title: Kusanagi Nene — Understanding Tokiwa Gozen〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, Nene!
We got it all on video!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Then, I'm gonna check to see how my acting went.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Roger♪
Lemme watch with you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I still can't do what everyone from Mikazukigumi can, but I feel like my sword fighting skills have improved a little.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which just leaves whether or not my portrayal of Tokiwa Gozen is doing her justice... I need to dissect every frame of this video.)

rows.Speaker: Video Nene's Voice
rows.Line: <I'm left with no choice...!>

rows.Speaker: Video Nene's Voice
rows.Line: <I was born into a family of warriors. If I must wield a blade to defend these children, then I shall...!>

rows.Speaker: Video Nene's Voice
rows.Line: <Hiyah!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(This video says it all...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm still not fully committing myself to this scene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is where she's supposed to show everyone that she's going to protect her children no matter what, but I'm struggling to capture that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which explains why I look a little too unsure when she hesitates to pull out her katana.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I guess I still don't entirely understand how she feels. I mean, I think kids are cute, but I don't have much experience interacting with them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Right...
But what can you do about that? Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh!
This might be a good idea!
A few days later
Odaiba Animal Land

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! I'm smelling the scents of so many different animals!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, zoos do have a unique smell to them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Also, this area...
The baby foxes are around here, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But is seeing a family of foxes really going to help me get a better understanding of Tokiwa Gozen's feelings...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, it's still worth a try...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Where do you think the foxes are?
Sniff... Sniff... Oh, that way?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're totally guessing... Huh?! Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, wait for me!
se_run_women_002_1
Petting Area

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They're really here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Look how the mom and her baby are rubbing their cheeks up against each other! That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But their eyes are only half open!
Does that mean they're sleepy?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It might be time for their afternoon nap.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, the baby's rolling around right next to its mom. Hehe. That's really cute.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I don't think just seeing this will tell me how Tokiwa Gozen feels about her children...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, this sign says, “Try holding a baby fox.”
They really let people do that...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, I know...!
Why don't you try holding one, Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Think about it! Holding one might help you understand what it means to love your children!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I kinda get that, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, lemme go ask one of the staff!
Excuse me, Ms. Staff Lady!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-It's so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's adorable!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(This is incredible...!
It's so tiny and fluffy... Like a plushie...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (B-But it really is tiny... I still can't believe we get to hold it... I need to be careful not to drop it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Maybe this is what it's like to see your baby right after giving birth...)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Alright, I'll hand it over to you now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, wait!
We came here today to help you, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, you get first dibs!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Please try to cradle it in a way such that you avoid placing any stress on its hips. Gently provide as much support as you can for its upper body and bottom.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Umm... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Yes, that's perfect.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Its fur's so fluffy...
Also, I didn't realize how frail its legs were...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But it's so warm...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think it's cozying up to me, which only makes me want to protect it even more.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh, it's blinking at me.
Hehe. That's really cute... No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It fell asleep...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it feels safe in your arms. It must really like the way you're holding it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Besides, it was rolling around right next to its mom just a second ago! Is it all tuckered out?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: That's certainly a possibility.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh, when did the mom wake up...?
She's staring right at me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She must be worried...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tokiwa Gozen must feel the same way. They both know what this irreplaceable warmth feels like. This desire to protect it at all costs...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You look so motherly right now, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... I think I have a little better understanding of what Tokiwa Gozen's supposed to be feeling.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
Hooray! That means Operation Baby Bonding was a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wouldn't have gotten a chance to do this if it weren't for Emu.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I've got to make the most of this experience, and become the best Tokiwa Gozen I can!)
